An '''armored tank''' was a vehicle used for demolishing buildings.<ref name="Inside">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]''</ref>

The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] used armored [[Tank/Legends|tanks]] to demolish homes and make space for the expansion of its [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]-based [[Imperial garrison base]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="Inside" />

==Behind the scenes==
Armored tanks seem to be the counterpart of real-world [[Wikipedia:Armored bulldozer|armored bulldozers]].
